summary.headline: Fresh Start links directly to device administration
summary.summary: The Fresh Start procedure now points directly to Devices and All devices and provides direct links for Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, Endpoint Security Manager, and custom roles.
summary.adminImpact: Before initiating Fresh Start, confirm the operator has an eligible role and the documented remote-task permission.

summary.headline: Full scan links directly to device administration
summary.summary: The Full scan procedure now points directly to Devices and All devices and provides direct links for Help Desk Operator, Endpoint Security Manager, and custom roles.
summary.adminImpact: Before initiating a scan, confirm Remote tasks/Windows defender and managed-device visibility permissions.

summary.headline: Locate device links directly to device administration
summary.summary: The Locate device procedure now points directly to Devices and All devices and provides direct links for Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, and custom roles.
summary.adminImpact: Before locating a device, confirm the assigned role grants Locate device or Play sound remote tasks and device visibility.

summary.headline: Shared-device logout links directly to device administration
summary.summary: The Logout current user procedure now points directly to Devices and All devices and provides direct links for Help Desk Operator and custom roles.
summary.adminImpact: Before logging out a shared-device user, confirm Remote tasks/Manage shared device users and device visibility permissions.

summary.headline: Lost Mode links directly to device administration
summary.summary: The enable and disable Lost Mode procedures now point directly to Devices and All devices and provide direct links for Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, and custom roles.
summary.adminImpact: Before changing Lost Mode, confirm Enable lost mode or Disable lost mode permissions and managed-device visibility.
